system.description:
Field Dressing is the skill acquired by soldiers in the field who are forced to tend to their own wounded. It imputes a bare knowledge of anatomy and assumes a splash of common sense.

Obstacles: See the Anatomy of Injury chapter in the Burning Wheel for Field Dressing treatment obstacles.

FoRKs: Herbalism, Surgery

Skill Type: Medicinal. Tools: Traveling Gear. Expendable.

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 272
